description: Air Masses and Electricity Demand in New England is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Cameron Lee, Erik Smith (Electric Power Research Institute). These datasets (.mat) and Matlab code (.m) are being made available in tandem with research entitled: Exploring the efficacy of multivariate air masses as a predictor of electricity demand: A case study in New England Cameron C. Lee (Kent State University; ClimRISE Laboratory; cclee@kent.edu) Erik Tyler Smith (EPRI) Email the lead-author (Cameron Lee) with Questions. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
